**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no indemnification article exists.**

The outline jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) straight to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability). Searches for "indemnif", "defend" and "hold harmless" surface only orphaned references that presuppose an indemnity article:

- **§ 9.3** — termination right depends on "the remedies required by Section 20.5" (which does not exist)
- **§ 19.4** — remedy is "not exclusive for ... indemnified claims"
- **§ 21.3** — Excluded Claims include "its indemnification obligations"
- **§ 30.5** — refers to "an indemnified party" and "vested indemnity rights"

So Vendor owes us no defence or indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents, or misconduct, and several existing provisions are unenforceable as drafted.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — inserted a new Section 20 after § 19.5, reaching the preferred position:

- **20.1** Vendor defends/indemnifies Customer and Affiliates for third-party IP infringement claims (Services, Deliverables, Vendor Technology), Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct
- **20.2** Narrow Customer indemnity, limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law, with an express statement that Customer has no other indemnity obligation
- **20.3** Standard procedure: prompt notice (prejudice qualifier), indemnitor control, cooperation at indemnitor's cost, settlement-consent protection
- **20.4** Customary infringement exclusions (Customer modification, combination, Customer specifications) — offered up front as the fallback concession
- **20.5** Procure/modify/replace, then terminate-and-refund — numbered 20.5 so the existing § 9.3 cross-reference resolves

Defined terms used (Services, Deliverables, Vendor Technology, Customer Data, Applicable Law, Affiliate, Fees) all track Section 1, and the new indemnity dovetails with the § 21.3 Excluded Claims carve-out so it is not capped.
